title: Add SECURITY.md with a private reporting path
summary: The repository now includes SECURITY.md so suspected vulnerabilities can be reported privately instead of in a public issue.
changes: Added SECURITY.md and linked it from the README.
version_rationale: Patch release: adds the missing security policy file without changing application behaviour.
validation: PHPUnit SecurityPolicyDocumentationTest covers the private reporting path and README link.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove SECURITY.md and the README link.
provenance: SECURITY.md private reporting path for issue #126, pull request #207.
